BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B2-
2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District and indications as shown on Map No. 7-J in

the area bound by:

North Wilson Avenue; the alley next northeast of and parallel to North Milwaukee
Avenue; a line 48 feet northwest of and parallel to North Dawson Avenue; and

North Milwaukee Avenue,

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Carlos Ramirez-Rosa
Alderman, 35" Ward

2847-61 North Milwaukee Avenue
